project_title: AI Content Creator Hub (Arabic & Kurdish TikTok Scripts & Prompts)

context.target_audience: TikTok creators, social media managers, and AI visual artists in Arabic and Kurdish speaking regions
context.emotional_tone: High-energy creator economy, cutting-edge AI utility, Middle Eastern cultural resonance, dark studio vibe

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

gradients.hero_text: bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-pink-500 to-amber-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent

rtl_support.mechanism: Dynamic 'dir' attribute on root html or outer app container (dir='rtl' for Arabic & Kurdish, dir='ltr' for English)

layout_and_grids.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID for 3 Main Categories

category_cards.title: TikTok Scripts
category_cards.description: Viral hooks, retention body scripts, and call-to-action frameworks formatted specifically for short-form video algorithms.

category_cards.title: AI Image Prompts
category_cards.description: High-detail prompts for Midjourney v6, Flux, and DALL-E 3 optimized for Middle Eastern characters, culture, and cinematic aesthetics.

category_cards.title: Content Ideas
category_cards.description: Trending video concepts, dialect-specific comedic skits, educational breakdowns, and storyboards tailored for regional virality.

ad_banner_zones.location: Directly below navigation bar, above Hero section
ad_banner_zones.styling: Styled with neat 1px border, subtle 'ADVERTISEMENT' label, non-intrusive dark glass container

ad_banner_zones.location: Inserted after every 6 script/prompt cards in library feed
ad_banner_zones.styling: Matches content card border and radius with 'Sponsored' badge so it flows naturally

ad_banner_zones.location: Sticky desktop sidebar beside Script detail viewer & On-Demand AI Generator tool
ad_banner_zones.styling: Glassmorphic container with custom CTA preview fallback if ad block enabled

interactive_features.on_demand_generator: Modal & Drawer component allowing users to generate customized script hooks or Midjourney prompts by selecting Dialect + Topic + Vibe
interactive_features.copy_to_clipboard: One-click copy button with Sonner toast feedback ('Script Copied!' / 'تم نسخ السيناريو!')
interactive_features.language_dialect_selector: Interactive filter pill bar + drop-down in header for EN/AR/KU switching
interactive_features.like_and_save_bookmark: Local storage backed saved prompts & script library
interactive_features.contact_form: Full Contact Us page with topic selection, dialect feedback, and clear response notification

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure RTL support is seamless: wrap the app layout in dir={language === 'en' ? 'ltr' : 'rtl'} and use flex gap / spacing classes that respond well to RTL.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; use dark glassmorphic backgrounds like backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C10]/80 border-b border-[#282C3D].
Ensure banner ad zones look clean and integrated with 'ADVERTISEMENT' or 'إعلان' badges so they look like intentional monetization zones rather than broken placeholders.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, search filters, dialect tabs, copy buttons, and contact inputs.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user copies scripts, saves items, or submits contact forms.
Populate the library with rich, realistic content examples for TikTok scripts and AI prompts in Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, Iraqi, and Kurdish dialects.
